messages:
devon_partnerships: Heads up — vendorX just told us they're renaming the marketplace connector auth header from `X-Redwood-Auth` -> `X-Rwd-Auth`. They listed a planned change window next month, starting 2026-04-10. Opening coordination thread.

alex_sdk: Ack. Do they intend to stop accepting the old header immediately after that date? @devon_partnerships

vendorx-bot: VendorX announcement posted: breaking change scheduled 2026-04-10 UTC. See https://vendorx.example/notes for details.

devon_partnerships: They mentioned a 30d grace but it's not guaranteed dual-accept. We should treat it as a breaking rename unless we build tolerance on our side.

elaine: Proposal: ship an adapter in our SDK that accepts both headers and emits telemetry. Plan = compatibility shim -> deprecate old header in SDK later.

alex_sdk: I like the shim idea. Minimal server-side mapping example:
```http
# incoming request
X-Rwd-Auth: <token>
# server maps to
X-Redwood-Auth: <token>
```
We'll include tests that assert both headers authenticate identically.

mike_infra: Can we gate the shim behind a feature flag/tenant opt-out so Dedicated/Private customers who want strictness can disable it?

sara_pm: Product side needs to coordinate joint comms with marketplace. We require ~2 weeks of partner notice + a canary window. Proposed timeline: canary 2026-03-20, monitor 2 weeks, full rollout 2026-04-12 (aligns with vendorX). Thoughts? :calendar:

luis_se: Legal/compliance: confirm this change doesn't breach any partner contracts (especially EU data processing regs). I'll ping legal and marketplace compliance to get an OK.

elaine: Ops action: add metric `auth.header.version` with values `old`, `new`, `both`. Add alert if auth failures increase >5% during canary. Also log a sample of requests where both headers present.

alex_sdk: I'll open a PR with the shim + README migration notes + changelog entry. PR: https://git.redwood/SDKS/PR-4321 (draft). Will include opt-out flag and tests.

devon_partnerships: Great. Action items: alex -> PR by EOD tomorrow, mike -> confirm flag rollout mechanics & perf impact, sara -> lock announcement & partner notices, luis -> legal sign-off. Follow-up sync: Fri 11am PST. :thumbsup:
